Delhi High Court to hear CBI plea on liquor policy case discharge

The Delhi High Court will hear a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) plea on Monday challenging the discharge of former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal and former Deputy Chief Minister Manish Sisodia in the liquor policy case. The CBI is appealing the discharge order granted by a trial court. The case pertains to alleged irregularities in the now-scrapped Delhi excise policy.
